name: Tom Perriello
subject: Final Vote Counted. History Lies Ahead.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TOM PERRIELLO FOR CONGRESS
body:
| | | |
---
| | |
---
Dear Friends, With the final votes counted and the race certified, we narrowed the margin to one point, moving the district 14 points from 2024 and nearly 7 points from Gov. Spanberger’s historic performance just last year. I just completed a thank you tour of the district, and dozens of people are already making plans to run for local and state office in 2027 – and our new Dem-majority City Council in Lynchburg is making plans to govern! The momentum you helped us create is still rippling across our region of Virginia. I wanted to take this moment to say thanks and to offer you a few thoughts on what this race has meant, beyond just the numbers. Here are my top ten takeaways from this campaign:
---
1. **Dems must show up everywhere and fight for every community.** We closed the margin by 14 points by making gains in every single one of the 21 counties and 3 municipalities. We visited every corner of this district, over and over again. From day one, we knew it was as important to make gains in our reddest counties as it was to maximize turnout in our bluest.
2. **Rural Virginia is not all red – and not all white.** One of my greatest hopes about Dem victories around the country is that the party will finally understand that rural regions include a lot of small towns that are getting bigger, bluer, and more diverse. We moved our rural counties 10 points bluer. We worked with farmers – white and Black – to release our FED UP agenda, and we enlisted over 200 doctors and nurses from across the district to endorse us and spread the word about the deep and growing cuts to rural health services caused by HR1. When you show up, listen, and actually fight for people they notice. My most urgent and public hope for our new Dem majorities in Congress is that they move immediately in January, not through regular order, to prevent the Medicaid and SNAP cuts that will further devastate rural communities. On Day One, they can bring down costs by removing authorization for this war and these tariffs, and on day two move swiftly to prevent a generational closure of health services across rural America.
3. **We turned Lynchburg blue and helped to elect the first Dem-majority City Council in a generation.** In the home of Liberty University, we worked seamlessly with three amazing local leaders to flip the city council, and that council appoints the School Board. Our race helped to bring resources and attention to areas that have seen little or no investment from the party. During my thank you tour around the district, I was moved to see how many people who worked with our campaign are now thinking about running for local or state office in 2027 to keep this momentum going!
4. **UVA students showed up in record numbers!** UVA students turned up to vote in even larger numbers than in the 2024 Presidential cycle. That is incredible! With a lot of leadership from campaign manager Lily Franklin – who had tripled student turnout at Virginia Tech in her race for Delegate the previous year – we exceeded all expectations for engaging young people in this campaign.
5. **We prioritized real grassroots operation.** 13,000 donors. More than 1,000 volunteers. 300,000 contact attempts. 50,000 doors knocked. 25,000 personal conversations. No corporate PAC money. No lobbyist money. Just y’all.
6. **Main Street populism builds our coalition, when we help communities stand up to corporate greed.** From fighting to block the Valley Link Transmission Line and data centers to fighting to protect rural health clinics, we made it a priority at every stage of the campaign to stand with communities fighting corporate greed and corruption. We ran 6 points ahead of the Democratic benchmark in this district and 14 points ahead of where we were in 2024. A campaign built on lower costs, common sense, and standing up to powerful interests can win rural Virginia.
7. **You believed in us, even when the national party did not.** This campaign ran on your donations. The national party chose not to make a real financial investment in our race, even when the polls showed it was winnable, but you believed in this race early and invested in us. McGuire had to get a late influx of millions to eke this out, and we did not get the same party support on our side, but you gave us the resources to fight this to the last vote.
8. **Be prepared everywhere, because you never know what the next election might look like.** Mississippi and Texas were ready, because state and regional leaders had been building for this kind of a year for many years. Two years ago, any rational pundit would have considered VA-05 unwinnable, but our campaign in this political environment proved otherwise. We cannot know what factors and demographics will shape the next few elections, so we need to keep fighting everywhere and for everyone. We need to be ready.
9. **The American people want national protections from AI, ASAP.** If we are looking for an issue that unites Americans on the right, left and center, it is the intense and broad demand for regulations, liability, and guardrails on AI. Perhaps my most pleasant and persistent surprise on the campaign trail was seeing the voters being so far ahead of both parties in their readiness for a national conversation, mobilization, and agenda around AI. I shared some of those thoughts in [The New Republic](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143420453/660152806/1269056589?refcode=261113em_tp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjIxMDkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDVmMDE5NTAtYmZkZi1mMTExLTkxZjAtMDAwZDNhMThlMjQ0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VLZjCnriz4ZdFdrY8gRUHCEmGgMLVK5QwL6607QbFQY=&emci=01c9cb79-bedf-f111-91f0-000d3a18e244&emdi=45f01950-bfdf-f111-91f0-000d3a18e244&ceid=18671963) [here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143420454/660152819/1269056589?refcode=261113em_tp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjIxMDkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDVmMDE5NTAtYmZkZi1mMTExLTkxZjAtMDAwZDNhMThlMjQ0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=VLZjCnriz4ZdFdrY8gRUHCEmGgMLVK5QwL6607QbFQY=&emci=01c9cb79-bedf-f111-91f0-000d3a18e244&emdi=45f01950-bfdf-f111-91f0-000d3a18e244&ceid=18671963).
10. **America finally got the 250th Anniversary celebration we deserved!** In every generation since our founding, America has faced questions of who gets to count as fully American and fully human, of whether we will be a more perfect Union that lives up to our bold promises of inalienable rights and equality under the law. The current Administration used every second of every day to create a dark storm cloud over this 250th year that should have been a chance to celebrate the enduring American experiment. Last Tuesday, we, the people, gave ourselves the greatest possible anniversary gift – a resounding national chorus of America the Beautiful, sung through every vote cast from the Delta to Detroit and Austin to Alaska, and yes from Charlottesville to Chatham and Lynchburg to Louisa. So many of us stepped up to run this year – and to donate, to knock doors, to poll watch – because we knew the future of our country was on the line. Together, through our victories and even our noble defeats, we dared not just to prevent the end of American democracy but also to make it more resilient, inclusive, and expansive than it has ever yet been.

---
For that, I say thank you. For that, I say congratulations. For that, let us celebrate, rest, and prepare for the work that must continue ahead. With love and determination, Tom

_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3994%2E259176%2Eb9zTDt) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3994%2E259176%2Eb9zTDt)_

If we haven’t met before, I’m a native of northwestern North Carolina who's spent forty years of my career working in local journalism, and I'm also the Democrat who is currently up by **335 votes** against Virginia Foxx, _**the second most-powerful Republican in the House.**_

This is the closest House race in the entire country, and it could also be one of the most important.

As Chair of the Rules Committee, Virginia Foxx directly blocked the House from voting on Trump’s tariffs and the release of the Epstein files. When Elon Musk and DOGE ransacked our federal government last year, she stood by and cheered them on. She’s made a name for herself yelling at reporters to shut up and screaming at staff for using the wrong elevator. And for twenty years, she’s stepped on the backs of working people in order to climb the ladder in Washington, DC, _**all while making millions playing the stock market.**_

Meanwhile, I spent my career reporting the truth at the local newspaper my grandfather started after WWI. I always made an effort to bring my readers just the facts without any bias. In that same spirit, my team and I are working around the clock to make sure every legal ballot in this race counts, because no matter _who_ they voted for, _all_ of our neighbors deserve to be heard.

**For the first time in decades, North Carolina’s Fifth District will be represented by a Democrat.** I’m ready to roll up my sleeves and get to work to lower costs and fight corruption in Washington – but Republicans are going to do all they can to ensure this doesn’t happen. **They’re going to challenge every single vote.** Just 335 votes could end Virginia Foxx’s political career and the decades of nastiness – **but this week will be the most critical of the campaign.** I need your help now to ensure we have the resources required to defend this seat and make sure our neighbors are heard. subject: Tell Your Senator: It's Time for New Leadership!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

The calls to replace Chuck Schumer are growing louder — and Our Revolution
is officially backing Sen. Chris Van Hollen for Senate Majority Leader!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40124?source=email-20261113&t=1011&akid=11599%2E5885482%2EMCWUlW ]Photo of Chris Van Hollen

After a historic election that put Democrats back in control of Congress,
the message from the grassroots couldn’t be clearer: It’s time for new
leadership and a Democratic Party that’s ready to FIGHT.

In our post-election survey of 4,308 Our Revolution supporters, 72% said
Chuck Schumer is NOT the right person to lead Senate Democrats.

Now, senators are beginning to make their decisions about who they’ll
support for leader — and we need to make sure they hear from US.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40124?source=email-20261113&t=1012&akid=11599%2E5885482%2EMCWUlW ]ADD YOUR NAME: Tell your senators to support Chris Van Hollen for
Senate Majority Leader!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40124?source=email-20261113&t=1013&akid=11599%2E5885482%2EMCWUlW ]SIGN THE PETITION →

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40124?source=email-20261113&t=1014&akid=11599%2E5885482%2EMCWUlW ]Headline: Chris Van Hollen launches challenge against Chuck Schumer to
lead Senate Democrats

We're delivering your signatures to the Senate on Tuesday, November 17th.
This is our chance to send a powerful message before senators cast their
votes.

Our Revolution is proud to endorse Chris Van Hollen because he’s shown
he’s willing to challenge the party establishment, stand up to powerful
corporate interests, and fight for a Democratic Party that puts working
people first.

As Our Revolution Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese put it:

"Working people organized to win this majority, and they expect it to
fight for them."

We didn’t organize millions of voters, flip the House and Senate, and
elect a new generation of progressive fighters just to watch Democratic
leaders return to business as usual.

We need leaders who will take on Trump AND the billionaires and corporate
donors who have too much power over BOTH parties.

Leaders who will fight for Medicare for All, get corporate money out of
politics, and stand up for working families — even when it means
challenging their own party.

That’s the kind of leadership we’re fighting for. And that’s why we’re
backing Chris Van Hollen.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40124?source=email-20261113&t=1015&akid=11599%2E5885482%2EMCWUlW ]TELL YOUR SENATORS — SUPPORT VAN HOLLEN!

For ten years, Our Revolution has fought to transform the Democratic Party
from the bottom up — helping elect more than 1,300 progressive champions,
mobilizing millions of voters, and challenging the corporate
establishment.

Now, with a new progressive wave heading to Washington, we have a chance
to change not just WHO holds power, but HOW that power is used.

But the decision is being made NOW. Senators are lining up behind their
preferred candidates, and we can’t afford to sit on the sidelines.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40124?source=email-20261113&t=1016&akid=11599%2E5885482%2EMCWUlW ]Add your name TODAY. We’ll deliver your signatures on Tuesday, November
17th, and demand that Senate Democrats choose Chris Van Hollen as their
next leader.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40124?source=email-20261113&t=1017&akid=11599%2E5885482%2EMCWUlW ]ADD YOUR NAME BEFORE NOV. 17 →

We fought to win this majority. Now we’re fighting to make it deliver.

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

body:
New FBI Records Reveal Crooks’ Venmo Account Suspended After Trump
Assassination Attempt

[INSIDE JW]

ILHAN OMAR COURT HEARING SET! CIA-JANUARY 6 COVER-UP!

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=39196&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9WSHVRZkZnQ2U1Zz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&H=a584cf618b79ea861f20144affdfce34b676667ef32b1ff6cb5df42b4e9d1bf2]

NEW FBI RECORDS REVEAL CROOKS’ VENMO ACCOUNT SUSPENDED AFTER TRUMP
ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT

We’re pulling more details of the Butler, PA, gunman out of the
FBI.

We forced the release of 142 pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=39171&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRob21hcy1jcm9va3MtcHJvZC0xMC0wMjIxNi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&H=0fc0be04a2901c606560c393bb7fcede89eac341f3fff1ea21c58df11b29053b] of
new, heavily-redacted Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) records
through a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit concerning Thomas
Matthew Crooks, the gunman who attempted to assassinate
then-presidential candidate Donald Trump at a July 2024 campaign rally
in Butler, Pennsylvania.

The records reveal that Venmo, a mobile payment service, suspended
Crooks’ account for “unusual activity” the day after the
assassination attempt, the FBI submitted a request for foreign
dissemination of information about images found on Crooks’
electronic devices, and PayPal repeatedly addressed him as “Rod
Swanson” in emails.

We filed our July 2025 FOIA lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=35667&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcmVjb3Jkcy1vbi10cnVtcHMtYXNzYXNzaW4vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&H=7aec6bcea17cffec2aeb27e839d6679c7a6c39f9d4bc0297e953e8d6a34f4d1e] after the
FBI failed to respond to a July 2024 request for records concerning
Crooks and the assassination attempt (_Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S.
Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=35650&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRob21hcy1jcm9va3MtY29tcGxhaW50LTAyMjE2Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&H=43462077c00b4c2d563fd5355b07fd4f7feb51f756d9a7ed7f84018f15976f9b]
(No. 1:25-cv-02216)). The Justice Department has indicated that the
total volume of records in the Crooks investigative file
is approximately 75,000 pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=38181&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYnV0bGVyLWFzc2Fzc2luYXRpb24tYXR0ZW1wdC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&H=ed48c1282177f5b2e8552720ba3ed178065a5ad24672e789f928f932c427a203].

At their current release rate of approximately 500 pages per month, it
will take over 12 years for us to receive the complete file. The FBI
is abusing FOIA by hiding, redacting, and slow-walking documents on
the Butler assassination attempt on President Trump. The FBI’s
handling of this matter is a scandal.

A July 21, 2024, FBI electronic communication
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=39172&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRob21hcy1jcm9va3MtcHJvZC0xMC0wMjIxNi1wZ3MtOC0xNi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&H=1b857cd7c255e2ddcee7e4dfeab28b8cc7f321e6087a9378b22f55ea9c4324bd] regarding
a “Gmail Database Review” reveals that Venmo suspended Crooks’
account on July 14, 2024 – the day after the assassination attempt
– citing “unusual activity” that might violate its user
agreement. In an email to Crooks, Venmo stated that his account would
remain suspended until the company heard back from him and requested a
copy of his photo identification.

A separate July 22, 2024, FBI electronic communication
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=39173&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRob21hcy1jcm9va3MtcHJvZC0xMC0wMjIxNi1wZ3MtOTMtMTAzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&H=c9e161d3238b964be38ca884932593e8560752576257bf473f062e0fe3dbf744] details
a “Gmail Database Review” revealing multiple financial
solicitations addressed to Crooks as “Rod Swanson.” A June 2024
email from PayPal stated: “Confirmed – rod swanson! You’ve been
invited to apply for the PayPal Cashback Mastercard,” addressing him
directly as “rod.” Two similar Mastercard solicitations and one
statement notification addressed to “rod swanson” are also
included.

A July 22, 2024, FBI electronic communication
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=39174&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRob21hcy1jcm9va3MtcHJvZC0xMC0wMjIxNi1wZ3MtMjUtMjgvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&H=9888cc433656a7568352d1b780306b85979adde609b7d620c504744b99279836]
details a “Foreign Dissemination Request” sent to international
intelligence partners noting:

> Numerous images of guns and various political and other key figures
> were found on Crooks’ device. There were multiple images of
> President Biden (POTUS) and FPOTUS, while other individuals were
> represented in only one to two images. A review of file paths
> associated with these images concluded the majority of the images
> appeared in cache and likely were web images, not photographs or
> video files.

> We are currently working to identify additional details related to
> these images. If we identify additional content related to
> individuals known to be citizens of your country, our Service will
> provide those details via an additional memorandum.

An FBI electronic communication
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=39175&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRob21hcy1jcm9va3MtcHJvZC0xMC0wMjIxNi1wZ3MtMjktMzAvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&H=bb2954422907aeb4bdfcd96d7b14d8f3f335792812f6cc3e6e0afc755bca9cda] titled
“Intel review for Bill of sale found on Crooks’ laptop for DPMS
Panther Arms sporting rifle” analyzes a bill of sale recovered from
Crooks’ laptop. Crooks purchased:

>> Blue Force Gear Adjustable sling with extra picatinny rail OD
>> adapter:
>> Allows you to control weapon movement and position flexibility.
>> AR Flip up sights:
>> Normally a scope is utilized as the primary method of aim, but if
>> the scope fails you can utilize the flip up sight.
>> Accu-shot 3-12×44 adjustable scope:
>> This is a traditional hunting scope which is lightweight, compact,
>> and adequate magnification range.
>> Vortex red-dot reticle:
>> The Vortex red-dot sight unlike some red dots with smaller aiming
>> points has a larger dot to focus on your target.
>> Eleven 30 round P-mag magazines:
>> This is a polymer AR magazine produced by MagPul designed to
>> augment/replace the standard stamped steel STANAG magazine. They
>> are available to hold various quantities from 5 to 60 rounds.
>> 1 magazine loader:
>> A device designed to load magazines at higher speeds and with less
>> effort than loading rounds by hand.

An FBI electronic communication
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=39176&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRob21hcy1jcm9va3MtcHJvZC0xMC0wMjIxNi1wZ3MtMTQ3LTE0OS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&H=64f38818fda4dcb3c85f148adc1b520f143529bf8831692ffab5f3280b7d4860] dated
July 16, 2024, details a search for Crooks’ passport and
foreign-travel information. A task force officer queried DHS systems
but was unable to locate passport information or foreign travel for
Crooks based on available identifying information.

The FBI heavily redacted an electronic communication
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=39177&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRob21hcy1jcm9va3MtcHJvZC0xMC0wMjIxNi1wZ3MtMzEtMzQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&H=f66156a90b3dee973562c9991c6179a407bc13bc3915f7556a9c18de122c4996] concerning
its analysis of Crooks’ laptop, withholding the entire substantive
portion of the report.

In October 2026, FBI records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=38821&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZmJpLXJlY29yZHMtdGhvbWFzLWNyb29rcy1tZXNzYWdlLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&H=7b256b70d64d0b231e9e0c43bc523d79c2a93db1de9689c11d9ef4efe47b301d] included
photos of the Pittsburgh area taken by Crooks using a drone, cell

for Sen. Raphael Warnock (D-GA), and an unusual chat thread between
Crooks and an unidentified person.

In September 2026, heavily redacted FBI records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=38666&F=T&&H=d5af8a0d5f3c3a8c41c0509dd5a59b3bb81da412a0fc178a2142e0b234abd91c] revealed
that Crooks purchased “a chest rig and ceramic plates,” exhibited
increasingly unusual behavior, including talking to himself, pacing at
night, staying awake for extended periods and exhibiting impulsivity
issues.

In June 2026, heavily redacted records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=38019&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcmVtb3RlLWRldmljZS1idXRsZXItc2hvb3RlcnMtcG9ja2V0Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&H=bfed83c3b470e52f166f468b5dd46ebbd79200689b26c3292defbdfe21b08de3]
from the FBI that indicated that a Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT)
officer at the July 2024 presidential rally for Donald Trump in
Butler, PA, recovered a “gray remote device” with an antenna from
Crooks’ pocket after he was killed.

In May 2026, we received

RECORDS

A federal judge has ordered a November 17 hearing on our push to
unseal records from the FBI search of Rep. Ilhan Omar’s
home—including the warrant, affidavits, and evidence supporting the
search.

Chief Judge James E. Boasberg set a hearing
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=39194&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL29tYXItc2VhbGVkLXNlYXJjaC13YXJyYW50LWhlYXJpbmctMDAxMTQtMDAxNDcvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&H=01b93a117a75d1e750497544cb2c2a636fa24cd0e8b57adee8f7ea9f491a4f81]
for next week on our and media requests to unseal the search warrant
and other records on the October 12 search of Rep. Ilhan Omar’s
(D-MN) home (_In re Application of Fourteen Press Organizations for
Access to Sealed Search Warrant Records_, No. 1:26-mc-00144 (D.D.C.)).

On November 12, 2026, Boasberg issued the following order
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=39194&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL29tYXItc2VhbGVkLXNlYXJjaC13YXJyYW50LWhlYXJpbmctMDAxMTQtMDAxNDcvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&H=01b93a117a75d1e750497544cb2c2a636fa24cd0e8b57adee8f7ea9f491a4f81],

> The Court ORDERS that the parties shall appear for a hearing on

We filed a motion
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=38971&F=T&&H=a3a37918649d932e9c3643fb5ee92c7856047fdc4c745a850e0d00cf1e65bec0]

October 12 search of Omar’s home, including the warrant, its
application, supporting affidavits and attachments, any return and
inventory, the docket sheet, and related briefs, motions, orders,
opinions, and transcripts. The request includes records concerning the
scope of the search and the court's decision to seal the materials.

We noted its interest in allegations concerning Omar predates the
search. On July 23, 2019, we filed an ethics complaint
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86580&L=38931&F=T&&H=e49c43089e7f2ac885ddb55065ec0843405328eff6ce3a6987cb44992c0a508c]
to the Office of Congressional Ethics requesting an investigation into
allegations of perjury, immigration fraud, marriage fraud, state and
federal tax fraud, and federal student loan fraud.

We argue that the public has a right to access the warrant records
under both common law and the First Amendment. Its motion states:

> [T]he public’s need for access is substantial. The government has
> searched an elected official’s home and has publicly acknowledged
> an ongoing criminal investigation, even to the point of commenting
> on its conduct. Representative Omar has disputed the government’s
> account and used the search and those comments to solicit campaign
> contributions. News reports based on unnamed sources have added
> accounts of the Court’s restrictions and the government’s
> requests. The public has a legitimate interest in understanding the
> factual basis for the warrant and the government’s exercise of its
> investigative authority....

The Justice Department wants to hide from the public basic information
about the search of Ilhan Omar’s home. At a minimum, the public
should be able to see the search warrant they handed to Ilhan Omar!

We have a record of successfully seeking the release of sealed
search-warrant materials in high-profile federal investigations.

An FBI electronic communication [] dated July 16, 2024, details a search for Crooks’ passport and foreign-travel information. The FBI heavily redacted an electronic communication [] concerning its analysis of Crooks’ laptop, withholding the entire substantive portion of the report. In October 2026, FBI records [] included photos of the Pittsburgh area taken by Crooks using a drone, cell phone evidence that showed that Crooks received fundraising appeals for Sen. Raphael Warnock (D-GA), and an unusual chat thread between Crooks and an unidentified person. In September 2026, heavily redacted FBI records [] revealed that Crooks purchased “a chest rig and ceramic plates,” exhibited increasingly unusual behavior, including talking to himself, pacing at night, staying awake for extended periods and exhibiting impulsivity issues. In June 2026, heavily redacted records [] from the FBI that indicated that a Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) officer at the July 2024 presidential rally for Donald Trump in Butler, PA, recovered a “gray remote device” with an antenna from Crooks’ pocket after he was killed. In May 2026, we received [], in response to a Pennsylvania court order, an audio recording of a 911 [] call placed by the father of Crooks []. In April 2026, our federal FOIA lawsuit forced the release of the first FBI records [] about the Butler assassination attempt, revealing that law enforcement personnel broadcast radio warnings about an “unknown male acting suspiciously” prior to the shooting. Also in April 2026, FBI records [] showed that Crooks was reportedly involved in an altercation with a group of people and making “hateful comments” directed at President Trump at the Butler, PA, rally. In August 2024, we uncovered [] documents under a Pennsylvania open record request from the district attorney’s office in Butler County, PA, detailing the extensive preparation of local police for the rally at which former President Trump was shot. The preparation included sniper teams, counter assault teams and a quick response force. In August 2024, in response to a Pennsylvania open records request, we obtained [] bodycam footage of the July 13 assassination events from the Butler Township Police Department. FEDERAL JUDGE SETS HEARING ON UNSEALING ILHAN OMAR SEARCH WARRANT RECORDS A federal judge has ordered a November 17 hearing on our push to unseal records from the FBI search of Rep. Ilhan Omar’s home—including the warrant, affidavits, and evidence supporting the search. Chief Judge James E. Boasberg set a hearing [] for next week on our and media requests to unseal the search warrant and other records on the October 12 search of Rep. Ilhan Omar’s (D-MN) home (In re Application of Fourteen Press Organizations for Access to Sealed Search Warrant Records, No. 1:26-mc-00144 (D.D.C.)). On November 12, 2026, Boasberg issued the following order [], specifically directing the government: The Court ORDERS that the parties shall appear for a hearing on November 17, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. on Petitioners' Applications to Unseal. The Government shall be prepared to address why materials beyond the Affidavit itself cannot be unsealed. We filed a motion [] on October 15, 2026, asking the court to unseal records related to the October 12 search of Omar’s home, including the warrant, its application, supporting affidavits and attachments, any return and inventory, the docket sheet, and related briefs, motions, orders, opinions, and transcripts. The request includes records concerning the scope of the search and the court's decision to seal the materials. We noted its interest in allegations concerning Omar predates the search. On July 23, 2019, we filed an ethics complaint [] to the Office of Congressional Ethics requesting an investigation into allegations of perjury, immigration fraud, marriage fraud, state and federal tax fraud, and federal student loan fraud. We argue that the public has a right to access the warrant records under both common law and the First Amendment. Its motion states: [T]he public’s need for access is substantial. The government has searched an elected official’s home and has publicly acknowledged an ongoing criminal investigation, even to the point of commenting on its conduct. Representative Omar has disputed the government’s account and used the search and those comments to solicit campaign contributions. News reports based on unnamed sources have added accounts of the Court’s restrictions and the government’s requests. The public has a legitimate interest in understanding the factual basis for the warrant and the government’s exercise of its investigative authority.... The Justice Department wants to hide from the public basic information about the search of Ilhan Omar’s home. At a minimum, the public should be able to see the search warrant they handed to Ilhan Omar! We have a record of successfully seeking the release of sealed search-warrant materials in high-profile federal investigations. In August 2022, we forced the release [] of a heavily redacted affidavit [] used to obtain the search warrant for the unprecedented FBI raid on former President Donald Trump's home at Mar-a-Lago. The release followed a court order [] granting our request to unseal the records. In August 2026, a federal court unsealed the key search warrant records [] behind the Biden FBI’s September 2022 seizure of Mike Lindell’s cell phone (In the Matter of the Search of a Person Located in the District of Minnesota (No. 22-mj-742 (TNL))). The records, unsealed at the request of Judicial Watch and Mike Lindell, show that the Biden FBI used private litigant Dominion Voting Systems’ then-pending $1.3 billion defamation lawsuit against Mike Lindell and others (a lawsuit that had been settled [] as to Lindell earlier this year) as well as other information from Dominion as part of its justification for seeking the warrant. We have also moved to unseal warrant materials targeting Rudy Giuliani [], Victoria Toensing [], and Michael Caputo []. JUDICIAL WATCH PROBES ELECTION INTEGRITY ACROSS THE NATION Micah Morrison, our chief investigative reporter, examines [] in Investigative Bulletin the post-election scene and our activities in support of free and fair elections. Judicial Watch closely monitored the mid-term elections. It’s a job we’ve been doing for more than thirty years, across Democrat and Republican administrations, as a national leader in investigating government corruption and election integrity. JW President Tom Fitton noted recently [] that we “keep doing what we’re doing, no matter who wins an election.” That includes probes of major election integrity scandals unfolding in real time in Alaska, Minnesota, and California. In Alaska, the Senate race between Republican incumbent Dan S. Sullivan and Democrat Mary Peltola has been engulfed in controversy. In late October, The New York Times revealed [] that Democratic political operatives and Peltola aides were deeply involved in a scheme to drain votes from the incumbent Republican by placing another Dan Sullivan—Dan J. Sullivan—on the ranked choice ballot. The Times reported that “not only did Ms. Peltola’s team work with people trying to recruit [Dan J. Sullivan] to run for Senate, but the effort was much broader. The group worked to coax other would-be spoilers into the race, to dilute the incumbent’s support and help catapult the Democrat to victory.... It also involved the Peltola campaign’s lawyers, as well as senior aides at the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee, which directs the party’s campaign strategy in Senate races across the country. From Washington to Anchorage, those advisers participated in regular conversations about the effort.” As of this writing, a victor has not been named in the Alaska Senate race. JW’s Tom Fitton called it “a scandal of epic proportions [ requiring “serious criminal investigations.” Probes have been launched by the Department of Justice, the House Oversight Committee, and the Alaska Department of Public Safety. In Minnesota, a different kind of scandal is unfolding. On October 12, federal agents executed a search warrant at the Washington home of Representative Ilhan Omar, a Democrat representing a Minneapolis district. Federal authorities are investigating immigration fraud and have issued more than a dozen grand jury subpoenas , the AP reported []. Among the items seized were a cellphone, notebooks, computers, and a passport. Omar dismissed the search as an “attempt to target political enemies.” The search of Omar’s home is shrouded in secrecy. Why the mystery? In a new court filing [], Judicial Watch seeks disclosure of the warrant and related documents, including an inventory of seized assets and supporting affidavits. Omar has not objected in court to releasing the records and has used news of the search in fundraising appeals. “Ilhan Omar is using this search to raise campaign cash, yet she hasn’t asked the courts to keep the records secret,” said JW’s Fitton. “Why is the government fighting to hide information about her alleged crimes?” Judicial Watch has been investigating fraud allegations surrounding Omar for years. In 2019, we filed a House Ethics Committee complaint [] calling for a full investigation into allegations of potential involving perjury, immigration fraud, marriage fraud, state and federal tax fraud, and federal student loan fraud. In California, Judicial Watch continues its historic efforts to compel the states to clean up dirty voter rolls, as mandated by the National Voter Registration Act. To date, JW has forced the removal of more than six million ineligible names [] from voter rolls nationwide, an election integrity endeavor unmatched in U.S. history. In May, JW sued California for failing to maintain accurate voter rolls—a requirement of the NVRA. The law requires the removal of most inactive voter registrations after two general elections. The JW lawsuit [] charges that California failed to remove an astonishing 873,000 inactive voters from their registration rolls who have been inactive for more than two general elections. Sometimes a lot more than two general elections: tens of thousands of the registrations have been inactive for over ten years. The lawsuit was filed on behalf of the American Independent Party of California and Don Wagner, an elected member of the Orange County Board of Supervisors. In July, the Justice Department filed notice that it intended to intervene in the lawsuit on behalf of Wagner and the Independent Party. Citing data from Judicial Watch’s original complaint, the Justice Department said in its Complaint in Intervention [] that California “does not comply with the NVRA’s requirement that the state conduct a general program of voter registration list maintenance that makes a reasonable effort to remove persons from the voter rolls who have become ineligible.” “Judicial Watch’s federal lawsuit confirms California has a dirty voting rolls crisis,” says JW’s Fitton. “Dirty voting rolls can mean dirty elections. California and its counties must take immediate steps to clean the over 870,000 dirty names on the voting lists.” The national numbers on dirty voter rolls are staggering. A sampling from Judicial Watch: California earlier settled a JW lawsuit against Los Angeles County resulting in the removal of more than 1.2 million names from voter rolls. In Oregon, a JW settlement [] ensured that 800,000 ineligible voter names are slated for review and removal from voter registration lists. Colorado removed 372,000 ineligible voter names thanks to a Judicial Watch lawsuit and settlement []. In Kentucky, state election board officials reported [] that “roughly 735,000 ineligible voter registrations” have been removed from voter rolls, as part of a 2018 consent decree settling a Judicial Watch lawsuit. The list goes on. For a full accounting, check out JW’s interactive Election Integrity Map []. The midterms are over. At Judicial Watch, the fight for election integrity and against government corruption continues. There’s plenty of work to do. name: Jane Fonda
subject: Our next move starts with you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee
body:
# [](https://act.janepac.com/go/30?t=1&akid=26%2E6803%2E25FBhg)
[](https://act.janepac.com/go/38?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261110_exit_survey.t1qSld&source=em20261114-26&t=3&akid=26%2E6803%2E25FBhg)
I want to take a second to check in with the heart of our movement: **you.**
**We helped elect over 215 courageous climate champions to offices all across the country!** Michigan. Texas. My home state of California. Pennsylvania. Georgia. The list goes on.
These fearless leaders took on corporate polluters, shady dark money groups, and even a trillionaire named Elon Musk with millions to spend. But they didn’t back down. Not for a second.
And on Election Day, we saw victories in places where change once seemed impossible. I’ll never forget that feeling.
You helped make a better future possible, and as we look toward the next chapter of our movement, I want to hear directly from you about where we go next:
_How are you feeling after Election Day’s results?_
_What message resonated with you the most?_
_What moment made you feel that hope was truly possible?_
**[Please take two minutes to share your thoughts. I’m personally reading your responses as we chart our path forward.](https://act.janepac.com/go/38?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261110_exit_survey.t1qSld&source=em20261114-26&t=4&akid=26%2E6803%2E25FBhg)**
**[Take the survey ››](https://act.janepac.com/go/38?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261110_exit_survey.t1qSld&source=em20261114-26&t=5&akid=26%2E6803%2E25FBhg)**
Checking in and showing up for one another is how people power grows. We cannot afford to take a single step back now.
**My team and I are making critical decisions for the fight ahead. We’re taking a hard look at what worked, what needs to shift, and how JanePAC can rise to meet this political moment with the moral courage it demands.**
But we can’t do that without the people who built this foundation.
**[Will you take two minutes to share your Election Day reflections?](https://act.janepac.com/go/38?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261110_exit_survey.t1qSld&source=em20261114-26&t=6&akid=26%2E6803%2E25FBhg)**
**[Take the survey ››](https://act.janepac.com/go/38?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261110_exit_survey.t1qSld&source=em20261114-26&t=7&akid=26%2E6803%2E25FBhg)**
**This work has never been about a single voice. It’s a chorus. And your voice belongs in it.**
Thanks for being here.
xx Jane

Fellow Republicans of the 5th District,

The 5th District GOP Chair Convention is today, Saturday, November 14, at Fork Union Military Academy. If you are a Delegate, you should show up 9am.

Virginia and our country face serious challenges. We need serious leadership in the 5th, leadership focused on winning elections, not internal games and retribution.

Ramona's opponent is supported by the current leadership. I'm not going to attack Ramona's opponent. But I am disappointed in the name-calling and false attacks that have taken place. We as a party can do better. Our energy belongs on defeating Democrats, not tearing each other down.

For too long, the 5th has been distracted by division at the exact moments we needed unity. The fact that we were the only one of Virginia's eleven congressional districts forced into a convention during this critical midterm is just one more reason we need new leadership. Maybe a better focus would have saved Rob Wittman.

Ramona Christian is that leadership.

While helping me win a race where even Democrats told me just yesterday they threw everything they could at us and were surprised we won, Ramona was key to our win. She worked tirelessly building relationships in every corner of the 5th District. She knows our counties, our activists, and what it takes to organize and win. She is ready on day one to lead the 5th District Committee, grow our party, and help turn Virginia red again.

I am proud to support Ramona Christian for 5th District Chair, and I urge you to show up and do the same.

See you tomorrow at Fork Union.

Michigan

Hey Peter,

I just got back from Washington, where I took part in orientation as your
senator-elect.

Walking in on the first day was surreal. Honestly, it felt a lot like
being the new kid at school.

I met up with many of my fellow freshmen, and chatted with a few folks who
currently serve.

Most people never hear about this. They don’t see what happens after
winning. Usually the emails stop, and the candidate disappears.

That’s not what I’m planning to do here. Instead, I’m taking you on this
journey with me,
Peter.

For months, we took on the power of corporations and billionaires and
special interests, and you held the line the whole way.

That tireless support paid off, and now, the real work (and fun!) begins.

I'll be sworn in on January 3, 2027. From now until then, our transition
efforts will be focused on building a team, getting ready to serve, and
setting things up so I can deliver for Michigan from day one.

Just like with our campaign, our transition work is fueled 100% by people
like you, not corporate PACs. [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261114-1-ak.-nOuZ2&amount=10&refcode=em20261114-3901&t=1004&akid=3906%2E251025%2EwxpUi9 ]So if you’re able to pitch in a few bucks

name: Stop Data Centers via Our Revolution
subject: Stop the AI data center gold rush
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

Outrage over AI data centers just helped usher in a wave of Democrats
pledging to rein in these energy-hungry behemoths. Now we have to make
sure they deliver.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40027?source=email-20261114&t=1011&akid=11594%2E5885482%2ExssOK- ]Headline: Did opposition to data centers fuel the blue wave?
Subheadline: For many Americans, AI infrastructure was a factor in their
votes.

People across the country are demanding that politicians stop giving Big
Tech a blank check to build at any cost. And now Our Revolution is going
all in to turn that demand into action.

We held a Data Centers Town Hall with Tom Steyer in Berkeley last weekend.
And on November 17, we'll join the Stop Data Centers Coalition and Rep.
Jim McGovern and other progressive lawmakers for a rally and petition
delivery demanding a federal moratorium on new data centers.

We need you with us.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40027?source=email-20261114&t=1012&akid=11594%2E5885482%2ExssOK- ]ADD YOUR NAME: Demand a nationwide moratorium on new data centers until
Congress puts real protections in place.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/40027?source=email-20261114&t=1013&akid=11594%2E5885482%2ExssOK- ]ADD YOUR NAME

Across the country, the people are demanding action to stop the data
centers destroying our communities. In just the first three months of this
year, 75 major projects worth more than $130 BILLION were delayed or
canceled. Of 41 local ballot initiatives concerning data centers across 10
states, all but ONE passed, reining in Big Tech.

We know what's at stake: millions of gallons of water consumed, scarce
resources diverted from drinking and farming, 24-hour industrial noise,
and skyrocketing utility bills. Meanwhile, ordinary families are left
paying the price for an AI gold rush designed to enrich the wealthiest
corporations on the planet.

The tech giants aren't backing down. They're racing to build hundreds more
facilities, while their deep-pocketed investors and lobbyists work to
prevent meaningful oversight.

If we don't keep up the pressure, they'll do what they've always done: buy
influence and stop our elected officials from taking bold action. We
refuse to let it happen.

Our first step is to push Congress to pass a nationwide moratorium on new
data centers until strong federal rules are in place to protect our water,
energy supply, environment, and communities. Big Tech is counting on
politicians to forget their campaign promises.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: What’s next for our Democratic majority
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Warren for Senate: https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/370?source=em-header&t=1001&akid=3079%2E4032634%2ECRJueS

After the 2026 midterms, the takeaways are clear: Democrats
won by fighting for working people and taking on powerful interests.

In the most competitive races, in blue, purple, and red states, including
Texas, Kansas, and South Carolina, Democrats won big by recognizing
Americans’ economic pain, calling out the Washington corruption that has
made our rigged economy worse, and pledging to upend this rigged system.

And Democrats need to carry that lesson into the next Congress and the
2028 presidential primary.

Some pundits want to chalk up this election to nothing more than a
referendum on the Republican Party and Trump's failures on inflation and
Iran. And yes, that's part of the story.

But those failures have a name: Affordability.

When Trump said high prices mattered to him, he won. But when he drove up
prices and enriched himself instead of addressing those costs, he lost.

Democrats need to pay attention to what voters rewarded: candidates who
named the rigged system, called out the billionaires benefiting from it,
and promised to fight for working people.

They were direct about who was rigging the system, who was profiting from
it, and who was paying the price.

Take James Talarico, the first Democratic senator from Texas in 30 years,
who said week after week on the campaign trail that "the system is
rigged." In the final stretch, he called out Elon Musk for trying to buy a
Senate seat. Talarico won by more than 10 points. In Texas.

Or in Ohio, my friend Sherrod Brown channeled voter fury against AI data
centers. When crypto bros and Big Tech billionaires tried to buy that
Senate seat for Republicans, Sherrod didn't mince words. He called out the
corrupt billionaires trying to buy power and keep the rigged system
working in their favor. And he won.

And in Kansas, Adam Hamilton won by calling for a crackdown on corporate
price gouging, stopping data centers from jacking up utility bills, and
expanding Medicare.

Every winner made these arguments loudly: Abdul El-Sayed, Troy Jackson,
Peggy Flanagan, Juliana Stratton, and so many more. Many did it in their
primaries, too, beating establishment candidates who were simply too timid
to call out the rich and powerful.

And these candidates weren't just TALKING about populism. They were
running on specific policies to take on powerful interests and make life
better for working people.

Now Democrats have to deliver.

Look, it would be a tremendous breach of faith with the people who voted
for us to spend the next two years railing against Trump and waiting for a
future Democratic trifecta to deliver meaningful change.

We must spend the next two years fighting to deliver for working people
now. Yes, even with Donald Trump in the White House.

If Republicans won't join us in passing bills that will make life more
affordable for Americans, Democrats will move ahead without them. Here’s
how:

The reconciliation process allows us to pass major legislation that
improves people's lives without a single Republican vote. With a 51-vote
majority in the Senate, we can reverse Republican health care cuts, expand
health care coverage, and fund universal child care. And we can pay for it
by reversing the tax breaks Trump and Republicans handed out to
millionaires and billionaires.

A Democratic majority can also send the president a resolution revoking
his authority to wage war in Iran.

And let's not forget one of our most powerful tools: Democrats have power
over spending bills that require our votes, and we should use it. No more
funding for a forever war with Iran. Cancel the looming cuts to health
insurance and nutrition benefits Republicans put in place last summer.

For legislation where reconciliation isn't an option, like banning stock
trading by federal officials or cracking down on Trump's corruption in
plain sight, Democrats should put the bills up for a vote. Let Republicans
decide whether they want to stay tied to that corruption. And if they do,
let's clear away Senate filibuster rules and pass the laws anyway.

It's true that these bills could still face a veto from Donald Trump. But
that's not enough reason not to try.

Democrats must deliver popular, meaningful legislation to Trump's desk and
dare him to veto it.

Dare him to veto an increase in the minimum wage for hard-working
Americans.

Dare him to veto a ban on price gouging.

Dare him to veto a ban on AI surveillance pricing.

Dare him to veto a ban on stock trading by federal officials.

Dare him to veto legislation that gets money out of politics so no one can
buy our democracy.

You can't win what you don't fight for.

And if we don't fight, if we hang back and sand down the edges of our
economic agenda or trim our ambitions because we're worried about what
rich donors or giant corporations might think, then shame on us.

I've already heard some Democrats accept defeat before we even tried
fighting for progress. That breaks faith with the people who sent us here.

Change can't wait. We must deliver now.

And we can’t ignore the need for accountability.

Congress has the power to hold Donald Trump and his cronies accountable
for ripping off the American people to make themselves richer.

Under the Trump administration, corruption has been massive, beyond
anything seen in American history.

Investigations are coming.

If you're a Wall Street executive, a Big Tech CEO, or a giant corporation
that has been cheating people, you should be worried. And government
officials who have put their own interests ahead of the public interest
should be worried, too.

Democrats are determined to make this economy and this government work for
hard-working people. And we have a plan:

Part One: Win the midterms.

Part Two: Deliver big change.

The time for Democrats to fight hard and produce results is now. And I’m
going to fight my heart out to make sure we use our power to make big,
structural change and hold the Trump administration accountable for
breaking the law.

Thanks for being a part of this,

Elizabeth

The next two years are critical to our country's future. Elizabeth Warren is
going to fight for working people, hold corrupt actors accountable, and push
Democrats to deliver real results.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/4884?t=1006&akid=3079%2E4032634%2ECRJueS ]If you can, donate now to power our work.

# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=3272%2E5691347%2E42hN6T)

We did it, Peter.
In sweeping and decisive victories, the American people rebuked the depravity, corruption, and incompetence of the failed lame duck President Donald J. Trump.
And if at times these last two years — amidst the ceaseless onslaught of brutality and indecency — you doubted whether our Republic would survive, let these historic victories give you courage that the first light of dawn is on the horizon.
It wouldn’t have been possible without you, Peter. I can’t thank you enough.
But our work isn’t finished yet.
Together over the last two years, we’ve affirmed that our task is not just to contain one president's wickedness, but to heal the brokenness beneath.
That this moment is an opening not for restoration, but for reformation.
So believe me when I say our most vital work lies ahead.
Defending voting rights and civil rights at home.
Restoring American leadership toward peace and human rights around the world.
Banning corporate money and secret money from our politics.
Guaranteeing health care for every single American.
It won’t be easy. And I still need you by my side.
Thank you for being a part of this.
Onward.
Jon

You know our work doesn’t end just because we’ve won the election. We still have bills to pay and we still need your help to keep building this movement.

New Jersey voters just sent a man who testified in defense of the Blind Sheikh to Congress. Meanwhile, a bill in New Jersey would give the state its first legal definition of "Islamophobia" -- one written so broadly that the very questions Adam Hamawy faced on the campaign trail could be treated as evidence of criminal bigotry.
[Assembly Bill 1146](https://substack.com/redirect/b53c473b-b4f7-4350-9fe6-9a2c04260085?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), sponsored by Democrat Assemblyman Joe Danielsen and co-sponsored by Assemblywomen Verlina Reynolds-Jackson and Mitchelle Drulis and Assemblyman Roy Freiman, was pre-filed and introduced on January 13, 2026. It was referred to the Assembly State and Local Government Committee, where it remains.
[| | | | | Laura Loomer
---
@LauraLoomer
🚨One week after the midterm elections, Muslim candidates have launched their own Islamic PAC and New Jersey has introduced Islamophobia legislation for "civil and criminal purposes". 🚨 Less than one week after the election of 8 Muslims across our nation, Michigan's dual ...
| 2:14 PM * Nov 8, 2026 * 158K Views710 Replies * 4.21K Reposts * 7.8K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/6217848a-1e35-474e-b4be-5a517326b1a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This is not a one-off. Danielsen has filed the same bill in each of the last three legislative sessions, and versions of it date back to 2021. Democrats in Trenton, New Jersey, keep bringing it back, and with Hamawy headed to Washington, they will have every reason to push harder.
The measure would supplement Title 10 of the New Jersey Revised Statutes with a definition modeled in part on one developed by a British parliamentary group. Its legislative findings lean on post-9/11 data on anti-Muslim incidents and argue that a uniform definition would aid monitoring and enforcement. The bill's own sponsor statement boasts that it would be the first state definition of Islamophobia in the nation.
Under the bill, Islamophobia is "a type of racism that targets expressions of Muslimness or perceived Muslimness," which may include hatred toward Muslim persons. The text lists specific examples, among them "making mendacious, dehumanizing, demonizing, or stereotypical allegations about Muslims, or of Muslims as a collective group, especially but not exclusively, conspiracies about Muslims' entry into politics, government, or other societal institutions, the myth of Muslim identity having a unique propensity for terrorism, and claims of a demographic threat posed by Muslims or of a Muslim takeover."
Read that again. Raising alarms about Islamists entering government, pointing out the connection between Islam and terrorism, and warning about demographic change are all written into the definition of Islamophobia in this proposed legislation.
The list goes further. It also counts accusing Muslim citizens of being more loyal to a transnational Muslim community, their countries of origin, or Muslim-majority countries than to New Jersey or the United States, along with exclusion and hostility toward Islam or Muslims as Islamophobia.
The bill carves out criticism of any Muslim-majority country comparable to criticism directed at other countries, and it includes a clause stating that nothing in the act shall be construed to diminish rights protected by the First Amendment or the New Jersey Constitution, or to conflict with existing anti-discrimination laws.
But the teeth are in the enforcement clause. Public officials and law enforcement officers reviewing alleged violations of the state's civil and criminal anti-discrimination laws would be required to take the definition into account when deciding whether an act was motivated by Islamophobia and discriminatory anti-Muslim intent. The state's political definition becomes the lens for deciding who a bigot is.
Now look at who New Jersey just elected. On November 3, Democrat Adam Hamawy, a Princeton plastic surgeon and former U.S. Army combat surgeon, [defeated Republican Gregg Mele with approximately 70 percent of the vote](https://substack.com/redirect/6f8f8eb8-b3df-4ada-a88f-bd18f9540886?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the heavily Democratic 12th District. When the new term begins in January 2027, he is expected to become New Jersey's first Muslim member of Congress.
During the campaign, Hamawy faced questions about his associations with Islamic terrorists, as did other Muslim Democrats on the ballot this year. In Michigan, Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed acknowledged that his [sister-in-law landed on the terrorist watchlist](https://substack.com/redirect/12742552-bd7d-4ebe-8f10-a09fec1e0982?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) during the Obama administration.
Court records show Hamawy met Omar Abdel-Rahman, known as the Blind Sheikh, in 1991, provided him with translation assistance, and [accompanied him on a 13-hour trip to a conference in Detroit](https://substack.com/redirect/dc190b86-c4ab-41df-aace-a2c9128c8a40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), where Hamawy told prosecutors he shared a hotel room with the cleric. He later testified as a defense witness at Abdel-Rahman's 1995 federal trial. Under questioning from prosecutor Patrick Fitzgerald, Hamawy testified that the sheikh "always talked about" jihad.
[| | | | | Laura Loomer
---
@LauraLoomer
New Jersey Democrat primary winner Adam Hamawy @HamawyForNJ was just EXPOSED for volunteering with the Benevolence International Foundation, an entity federal courts and the 9/11 Commission explicitly designated as a front group used to fund Osama bin Laden's AL QAEDA network. ...
| 7:20 PM * Jun 6, 2026 * 183K Views150 Replies * 3.95K Reposts * 8.22K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/fb5f46cd-c941-4b84-91fc-9426dda12114?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Abdel-Rahman was convicted of seditious conspiracy and related charges connected to terrorist plots, including the 1993 World Trade Center bombing; he died in prison in 2017. Hamawy has stated that the connection was limited and that he testified out of a sense of civic duty. On the campaign trail, he [dismissed the sheikh as "a blind old man."](https://substack.com/redirect/90b9e57d-d0c6-4395-96e5-314af2beb2df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

That wasn't his only brush with the jihadist world. In 1994, Hamawy spent several weeks in Bosnia [volunteering with the Benevolence International Foundation](https://substack.com/redirect/24ba0d44-618b-409b-8f4a-84af4103d2f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to deliver medical supplies. The organization was later designated by U.S. authorities as having provided support to al-Qaeda and remains sanctioned. Hamawy has described the work he did in Bosnia as humanitarian, and he has highlighted his subsequent military service, including a deployment to Iraq in which he treated then-pilot and current US representative Tammy Duckworth.
During his campaign, Hamawy also embraced far-left streamer Hasan Piker, who has publicly said "America deserved 9/11." Piker [rallied with Hamawy in Trenton](https://substack.com/redirect/57accaf9-7255-4be8-b001-ccef1e24a7a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ahead of the primary, and when Hamawy was later asked about the 9/11 remark, he [said it should be viewed "in perspective."](https://substack.com/redirect/0dc7ee5c-10b8-4c8d-b1fb-b390a7d9c447?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Since winning, Hamawy has been drawing fire for his soft line on the Iranian regime, which, according to Iran International, [killed more than 36,000 of its own citizens](https://substack.com/redirect/68626def-fb49-4730-a8f0-4819dec0094e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in its crackdown on protesters in January.
In [an interview Tuesday with CNN's Pamela Brown](https://substack.com/redirect/3994cff8-e0e6-43a4-b379-4ee51e76d86c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Hamawy repeatedly refused to say whether Iran is an adversary of the United States. "We pushed them into a fight," he said. When Brown noted that Iran's leaders have chanted "Death to America" for decades, Hamawy answered, "We've been saying 'Death to Iran' for decades as well." When she pointed out that Iran has killed many Americans, he replied, "And we've killed a lot of them as well."
[| | | | | RNC Research
---
@RNCResearch
Insane exchange. Newly elected Democrat Adam Hamawy refuses to call Iran an adversary. BROWN: Do you see Iran as the adversary? HAMAWY: "We pushed them into a fight" BROWN: But are they the adversary? HAMAWY: "We should be making friends" BROWN: They've been saying "death to ...
| 5:45 PM * Nov 10, 2026 * 1.95M Views1.22K Replies * 1.69K Reposts * 5.58K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/95f73d56-268f-42c4-b688-92d583ac4ab0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Brown's questions were about a foreign government, which the bill carves out. But imagine a New Jersey voter putting the same question to the congressman himself: whose side are you on, America's or Tehran's? Under the proposed definition, accusing a Muslim citizen of being more loyal to a Muslim-majority country than to the United States is listed as an example of Islamophobia. Asking the obvious question becomes evidence of bigotry.
The breadth of this definition, particularly language treating discussion of terrorism patterns or political participation as potential Islamophobia, could chill protected speech and complicate law enforcement and foreign policy debates. This is how Sharia-style blasphemy laws begin. Look at Saudi Arabia, which last month [executed two Bangladeshi expats](https://substack.com/redirect/9223f874-1fd3-4fa5-921c-8eee5c145456?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for what authorities called an "indecent act" inside a mosque in Mecca. The Saudis never said what the act was; online reports claimed it was a kiss.
New Jersey isn't alone. **Good Morning**! On this day in 1969, [Apollo 12 lifted off from Kennedy Space Center](https://email.editor.joinflyoverflorida.com/c/eJyk0EGynCAQgOHT4A5LGETfgkU27ibbLK0WGqcTbCxgtOb2qeQK7wJ__fX9eq5PoES8_4QDXcxxZbxrwtawrAF5f6OHirVQJd4PTFt-F171oK1USiqzgm904WqgC24yMwxbh05NX8aOj2nS3ctt3igMdjajxRDiNoc5mtHaAGOcRzV15P71lFJGDaNVqo96tAa3eTDx6zEPIMyAgVou_e9MHNMnX1hiyoUC9D4fXXKv1s4qHj-EXoRe7vvuGSr0e76EXjxyw1IlcJARPCVqhFXo5Q8yY_gIvRQ8EZo8scRcDmCPEs6cUpZKS_AvwgurrOgzB3nkzDIBB-Jd6KUrLpw3pUTVTsIM-wGU_n-1b5JeTv8NAAD__3A5jj8) into a rainy sky, and lightning struck the rocket twice within its first minute. The crew pressed on to make the second moon landing. A [pair of pants](https://email.editor.joinflyoverflorida.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAURb8Gd1jwwCYpKLZxl223tMB-OEQYIsBB3q8feaT5gmlec949urr_HvPD-ODj9tfsqF1yc8RWAtaKeV4xbgcupmDJvvi47RhsOnKcgcFIOadczmap_oOzNN2qlbwZZjvUXN3lOAiloHtqBGstLCgUB2aFujPlBJOolBVyMLLz-vJxziVnw8h572AYJdobk-4ubswQyXD1NeX-lXx04UwfzC6k7FfTL2nvgn7W-i5E_CEwEZhaa317PbcLEpguPYGJ8-sAgWk3kTqz-LhRoGv6j5E6DCl6LLSZUFOkSzpiPWlM7frEQoWke8pIrTl_4Irvo16ZYk4CU5f1-m4-BF9GRSTbduPDd7_6y2k_Gr4CAAD__-nfjY0) spotted in body camera footage helped Bay County deputies tie a man to 34 new felony charges, and the details are in _Around Florida_. ## Nationwide FAA Ground Stop Halts Flights
The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ordered a nationwide ground stop for departing flights Friday, following a communication issue affecting air traffic control centers, [halting travel at airports across the country](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OrDAMBeCnCV1G-YVQpLgN3dx2SxQSA5YyAREPo337FewjbG3LPt_5eo7PgBnL8j-8wBPNY4FPzUAEx1gC4VY-mGAOYTm2d0mVtn2CUQnVcim5NGOIhCeMJjTJT0r2wcQGvOx601pjpWhW72SwWrgo2sn1Uds-dabt7WR1itFC26C_DkopjZTCKffQyanO2Sj11HWT0cwISEjb8aAVCEqBWgHm_L2dcDzi9mqyX4n2yvQ_pgamhrBfkGvE1JDxBKaGXwK_DDyceOv4nHFZqfJrnb_3FAjqTdP8CtUcPu0fzBlr2zEjllfAfH-kP9Z1evUTAAD__wLDfzE). As of 8:45 p.m. EST, the FAA said airplane departures could resume after the agency lifted the nationwide ground stop. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said FAA technicians were investigating. At [Nashville International Airport](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2unTAMwPGnCVsQccLHGTJ0YbtdOyJDzCFSSFDiS3TevqId-gBdvFj6y_79-lq-0Acf3z_xJMu8L5FqCcRMeYnIPsXqHe2I75y-oyucrpUW6GCQSkllFtzY37QYbJxdQb3QbA1ZNb7M0Jtedc1hte5fsLmdjIPBAbitc_1ACHroej1i4-0TVEoZpboJpla7Ccap35Rex3E1WpiOnOeUWz6IKUYqhWgPn3RTbrd0NsEezFcR-oeAWcBca21rOe9nKWB--gJmpZ6hBcwRy3H7EEiiz1fKLB1dmPk7k1wTZldkOVKVz_flyoROOgr4KRJ3piz_2ci_MvKhETA32bqr-hB8GUZhuveJPvw5kf_T97bwOwAA__8tkZGI), flight boards showed widespread delays and several cancellations, leaving travelers stranded and scrambling. ## Ground Stop Strands NC Travelers
A rare nationwide ground stop halted every departure from North Carolina's airports for more than four hours Friday. The Federal Aviation Administration issued the order around 4 p.m. after what Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy called a [communication issue affecting all of the country's Air Route Traffic Control Centers](https://email.editor.flyovernorthcarolina.com/c/eJykkL2OhSAQhZ9GOwwg_lBQbGN3t93SjDAqCYKBudfs22_c3H2CrSaZL99kzvl6zA_wwcftEw40a7RzxKsEJMI8Z__CXGw6sOzpQErRFgJCN0sueyYEE2o-cyonWppF7cwwtL12NRoxaNV3quO63g1Yzm3X6nZxiwbbq2WQIFuB49j2iKL25j4ohFBC8FHqZnR2WaVTuus6jaOuFEfnKeVmDd_phTmmTLuFnIKP0Nh01MHsRGep2o9KTpWcrutq7FLEcNNKTneue9wi-zPZewshsOyebA1-26mwLadndOgYHN6xFaCwCORThPBmrFA6KznV2bjz8iH40g-V4tsBPvw-RP-t82XkTwAAAP__2LmNdw). Arriving flights were still allowed to land. ## Rivers Comes Home to NC State
NC State hired former Wolfpack quarterback Philip Rivers as its head football coach Friday. The 44-year-old [signed a five-year deal](https://email.editor.flyovernorthcarolina.com/c/eJyk0LGOpDAQBNCvMZkR3dgYBw4uIZtLL0TGboaWDEbGGm7_fjWzn7BxSVV69e8xPzwnPp5__U5uPcJ80H0lqpXKXPhF5Qp5p2vLO9V8hKv6SnHGDgcJIEHNZ8nXSaHO0ERnTD_Y2JADY9Wgle5ss7lIo-ksLWgGC7j2y9KDH9EuajShW0PD7l0IAAqgG9G2YwzLilFZrbWl0QrVUeSaS7umr_yicuRSt-BLTnz4NuS9SW6r9bxE_0fgJHC677u9_zMDvmOBky-VQyKB07lx4lP-8OQR5EclN_JRrjnXxackQ_ZhEzgZpVBrDU1x8bw5Jb4GI1T33D2nz3L97W8vh98BAAD__83ng20) and will be introduced Monday. He replaces Dave Doeren, whom the university [fired after 14 seasons](https://email.editor.flyovernorthcarolina.com/c/eJyk0D2u4yAUxfHV4I7IYLBNQTGNu0w7pcXHJUbCXAuuHM3un5ItvPpIRz_9_z33p8sl19dfd4JNNewV3r0AEbS95RtaD3hCP_AEwho6OYK4y1HOXAgu1H417BcE2sUQ7bJMs4kDWLEYNWulRzMcdnFrmvTqnfRBejF6mVJagnImrmlyccj2cyiEUEKMqzSPNQafZFRGa21gNUyNEDNhe6TyH29oFRsdwTUsubpHwHMo9iC6Opv-MLkxuTkfhPgsTG4XdmJyq4F__TzlBp1HdwOPCA0qr-6Ezglj5C8E76HwXAlaPnlCJO9K4QFdOJjchDHLrGfN5DY0G693LiX3eWFqfJ0uly-HfhvztvInAAD__7V4i24). His son Gunner, a quarterback, committed to NC State in February.
## Cherokee County Residents Protest Data Center
Cherokee County residents protested outside their electric cooperative’s office Tuesday over a possible data center near Grape Creek Road. Neighbors [learned of the project](https://email.editor.flyovernorthcarolina.com/c/eJykkL2u2zAMRp_G3hhYiuRYg4cu3m7XjgYj0ddC9GNIdFK_faECfYJuBL9zCJK_vtYv9MGn758Yad6SXRN9aiBmKmvxbyrV5kh1z5E4J1sZmdwqBzmCECDUepRcD7K8it7Nj8d9NK6nWTyMGrXSg-n3WbrNGKW1UpMli1ppjXi3k1GjU0bb3s9toBBCCTFM0twmZ5-bbKHWhibTqYGc51xuW7jym0rKhXeLJQef8GZz7MO8Mx-1u__o5NLJJeYzMfr0u6WdXNpdnVxsjvFMni_419ip5BcR2CZcUKh6R4krbPlMDvLJgA0Gh4xgKTGVBgcHTwKfgHeCTy6v2qoLsFBi2PE4LsBn0z13cunL7I6PD8HX8dGp4TuiD3835__9-3uWfwIAAP__atudTg) from Blue Ridge Mountain EMC workers placing survey flags near their land. No permits have been pulled, and construction hasn’t started. The co-op’s CEO, Alan Glidewell, told protesters the decision belongs to the board, which meets Nov. 17. ## Season's First Freeze Arrives
The [coldest air of the season](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSpCAQhp9GMyxA1JmA4BKzufRCq4UGqUOwoHfc2affcmrfYJOOur76v-_fY3lAiCH5v7CjJu-WhGeNSIRlcaFUcgXxC7cPH_GV8h4SEC6Sy5EJwYRajpLrgYYW0Vrdc4tC3VrUYrqrcVBTr9pN2xXvBlY12vukOLjB8XXsV-76id_MyNugL6IQQgkhpFCdnLiTq8GBgwW89Y3iaAPl0tGGHnPxAVx85SeWzuS9jXojOmrT_2nk3Mj5PM_O5c8BKEIiuH4aOV9ujZyhGAqGrREqsbWE5EPyLOVCG_thV_aWZ67k970asBPxPybbFm2PM8QY6jg1ivsdQnyvoN8WfGr5HQAA___PDYpX) has settled over the state, with a freeze warning in effect until 9 a.m. today for much of north and west Georgia. Forecasters expected lows of 25 to 30 degrees across north Georgia overnight, with a hard freeze in the mountains and frost possible around metro Atlanta. Highs will stay in the 50s this weekend. The freeze threat spreads farther south Sunday morning. Southeast Georgia is under a [freeze watch](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOozAQgOGnMR3IMziYFC6uocu1VyLHjMG3BiN7Eiv79Kus9g22_qWv-P_d5psNMRzrX7uT4dXPB9USiZny7EMu7DPRJ22PNdLrSHs4LNOMEocWoAU1nzmVkxzP0CymlwuBGhsyoK9quCjdq2YzvUbyHuButR60t875kQboEa6X0V5VE8xbBAAFAAiqQy093h1dpF0sjb1QkpbAKXe80Uopr8H6-EpPyp1LexPNxnwW0f8ROAmcaq1d_e_iOwqcbObgIgmcSnrwRrZw-6O0MVWXHgfnV-tzKtzyFkpbiT7oWAROWimUQy-bbJazhhhDGbRQct1t-PYb_u24p8GvAAAA__8JdIUE) late tonight into Sunday, with inland lows in the low to mid 30s and lower 40s at the coast. In South Georgia, [patchy frost is possible early Sunday](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGupDAQBNDTmMyINgaGwMEmZLPphshjt8Fag1G7d6zZ03_xr_CTSkp6KtWf5_q0McVz-20PNLyF9cRaEjIjrSFS4UCI_3H_tyX8nPmIp2VcVadGCSBBrxflcqHjFRpv-s4j6EeDBqZZj4Oeet3sZhpdGMHalx713M9qGILzbu7m3s0A49REc4sAoAFAgW7V1AX1cjh01lt89EJ36CNnannHDTNt0Yb0yW-k1uWjSWZnvorofwm1CLXUWttq0-suhVpuXagF4I5eqIXQ-o_MJM_MssaTkaQlim8sskbepcvJS8bjKjJQLix5j0VWxL94eqGWhoy_akwplnESutsOG9P3FP7pjW-jvgIAAP__mrCICA), and freezing temperatures are most likely north and west of Albany. Forecasters urge residents to protect people, pets, plants, and pipes.
## Hugley Nominated as House Speaker
Georgia House Democrats nominated Rep. Carolyn Hugley of Columbus for speaker Thursday, putting her in line to become the [first black speaker in state history](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O5CAQhU-DM7cojP8Cgk2c9aYbWrVQGLTYWFDdrd7TjzwzN5jkRU_f-_lzX-8YUzy237iT4c2vB71qImYqq4-lsi9E_yk8tkTvI-_xQKZVSTW0AC3o9Sy5nmR5hcaZTjoCPTVkYJz10Oux000wUzfMs_fYWav7fkYvQY7g7WwnmLXum2guIgBoAFCgb2qUXv211Et0SFMntCQXOZcbB9ooly2iT-_8pHKzeW-SCcxnFd0voRahlpIfW3AFPSMnPBgvl1DLFSPUAnCJEmr5ZrUhPyq1jvZsC3Jtvwa39ST8R6VNhI5KDfEUammKcecrphTrMAottx1j-qzBP73wadRHAAAA__8I1Ic-). If the full House confirms her in January, Hugley would succeed Speaker Jon Burns, R-Newington, and become the first woman elected to a full term in the post. Republican Rep. Jan Jones served as acting speaker from late 2022 into 2023. Democrats also chose Rep. Billy Mitchell of Stone Mountain for speaker pro tem and Rep. Stacey Evans of Atlanta as majority leader. The FAA [ordered airports across the country to hold all departing flights](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLFutDAQhJ8GOp-wMfincPE3dJc2JVrsBVYx9sneg9zbR-QeIdUUnzSabz7v0x0oUFw_YEfLxzJFPEtAZszTArDm9Iy-LIHWjQufiTeIX5NqVC-kFFJP4JgOnDTU3i6gEYYarTSD7jttOl1vdugHg40e_Nz-m7Hvm6XtvMPZuN5J13Q12atPSqmllKptb_M8dKrrGqMGo7SZK92gJ075xhselFeKBEt4pQPzzaW9DnZjfpSq_V-psVLjWZAvUKnx8rkCmFIUZ8rBV2pcAASV8sQi3uQkj-JtKwqnh3DEWAR-c4aUPUXIL-Eou-deGKLDUmfrHyeFQKU3lW7WHSj8ruE_HnlY9RMAAP__sZuMXw) Friday afternoon, citing "extraordinary circumstances." Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin blamed a telecommunication outage, telling reporters, _"This isn't another 9/11."_ Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said technicians were tracking down a "communication issue," and Mullin saw no link to Thursday's global Microsoft outage. Only twice before had the FAA halted departures nationwide on this scale: on Sept. 11, 2001, and in January 2023, when a failure of the pilot-notification system grounded flights. FlightAware tracked more than 12,000 aircraft in the air worldwide Friday. The FAA [lifted the nationwide ground stop](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQhZ8GukQe_2BcuNgmXbbdEg32GEbrQGRmifbtr7ivcMujI52j7_vznJ7IlbflN74oylmmjT5HJRFqU0Fc2v5vy0epvKxyyGeXFbe_k1Z6uAHcwE6YhE-aLPY5FrSEoacIPtjBWe9sv8YxgB3GFFRShDBkQh8CJPCpFDcG6DleewBgAUAbc5_n4LRzyuvgtfVzZxVllr3dZaWT28IbY6n_95PaPe2vvsZV5H105lenH51-4PvCuKorNOFUqdOPMsKsgrLGQMaCeQBjig5ArjgDOPYt5veHa-Vj8J1Vywu5fh_ID92cUX8FAAD__xa6dmY) at 8:15 p.m. ET Friday, but delays and cancellations continued as airlines worked to restore schedules. Travelers should check with their airlines for updates.
## Most Seniors Can't Afford Assisted Living
Only 18% of older Virginians earn enough to cover assisted living where they live, [a review by the General Assembly's watchdog agency](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uwyAURp_G3rAMBv8MDF2ypWtH62Iu9m0xRECI-vZVIuUJOp9Pn47O13W9AnkK-yecqEt1a8BH9lgKptUB7Cneg83O036UXB6xHBB-VtGLkXHOuFxhK1RxldBa7UAiLC1qPi1yVHJSsj20GOZhMkptfBbzZnoHs7EKURo5qtFAS_r5xzmXnHMxDJ0xixJK9ZNYJiEn08geLZWYunJgpbRTIHD-N1ZM3RbP1uujlFtuho9GXBpx-faQtu697PZYG3HxECyFnb3k3ywzyJlyQcs81Sd2sJGnQpgZBMsosCOeyDKmShtm5mJi0VtMDOzdl9xBvrVJ29uDvKc8To3s9xPIv8zKP6NWLf4CAAD__91-j8Q) found. Average monthly assisted-living costs rose 32% from 2021 to $6,940 in 2025, with regional rates ranging from $5,734 to $8,725; memory care costs about 30% more. [Del. Josh Thomas, D-Prince William](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkT2O3SAURldjdzzx-xgKF2ncTdqU1gUu9k14MALG1uw-cqSsYKqv-XSko_PrfXsHylT2n_DCZZxpK3j1jGNg2xLA3upniT1l2o_Rx1XHAeXPJrl8MiGY0BuEQSduGua4JNAIbsZFWKefRluj52PRKCwozoU3GLx5Om68RIVRvXGIIc603DwhhBZCSKUe3jsjjeFWOiu19ZPmGGnU9hgHntR2KgQpf9UT2yPU15yXY4yPPqkfk1wnuV7X9RDqVin1uh-TXKENChknuWZK9_wHsd8ZWmANT8KLJSqxM-id-sDIMp1UdhZqH51RCQ2hU9nzF_sskFJtEXxGlmpjHQvV1ie5SieYcCpZ9aaYNSYyzYNjXqJl3juOGrlJYOa2xI-Lcqb-tJPm-wso_xMa32xxLvJvAAAA__9cpZ_O), said at Monday's commission meeting that "about 80% of seniors will never be able to afford under our current system any type of assisted living."
